findings.title: AI agent can reach a credential or privileged tool: project:corpus → slack → SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
findings.description: An AI agent's tool-use chain reaches a credential or privileged tool node. A compromised or prompt-injected agent could harvest those credentials, turning a single agent into a lateral-movement pivot. Agent project:corpus can reach 1 credential/privileged tool node(s) along its tool-use chain (agentic credential-harvest exposure).
findings.remediation_guidance: Broker credentials through a short-lived token issuer instead of exposing them to the agent, and scope the agent's tools to the minimum required.

evidence.detail: Agent project:corpus can reach 1 credential/privileged tool node(s) along its tool-use chain (agentic credential-harvest exposure).

findings.title: MCP plaintext secret on slack
findings.description: MCP server 'slack' holds a literal secret value in its configured environment: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.
findings.remediation_guidance: Rotate the value, then reference it from a secret store or an environment variable set outside the config.

evidence.rule_id: plaintext_secret: MCP server 'slack' holds a literal secret value in its configured environment: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration K8S-007: Secret in plain env value
findings.description: Container 'vllm' in 'vllm' has env var 'HF_TOKEN' with a hardcoded value instead of secretKeyRef. Use Kubernetes Secrets with valueFrom.secretKeyRef.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration DOCKER-002: No USER directive (runs as root)
findings.description: The final build stage sets no USER, so the container runs as root by default. Add a USER directive with a non-root user.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration K8S-006: Writable root filesystem
findings.description: Container 'vllm' in 'vllm' does not set readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. A read-only root filesystem prevents attackers from writing malicious binaries.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration GHA-002: Action not pinned to a commit SHA
findings.description: 'actions/checkout@v4' resolves a mutable tag or branch. Pin remote actions and reusable workflows to a full commit SHA.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration GHA-002: Action not pinned to a commit SHA
findings.description: 'openai/codex-action@v1' resolves a mutable tag or branch. Pin remote actions and reusable workflows to a full commit SHA.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration DOCKER-010: FROM without digest pin
findings.description: Image 'node:22-alpine' is not pinned by digest (sha256). Use @sha256:<hash> to guarantee immutable base images.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration K8S-008: Using default namespace
findings.description: Resource 'vllm' uses the default namespace. Use dedicated namespaces for workload isolation and RBAC.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration K8S-010: Service account token auto-mounted
findings.description: Resource 'vllm' does not set automountServiceAccountToken: false. The default service account token is mounted into every pod, enabling lateral movement if compromised.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration K8S-013: No securityContext at pod level
findings.description: Pod 'vllm' has no pod-level securityContext. Set runAsNonRoot, fsGroup, and seccompProfile.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration K8S-004: No resource limits
findings.description: Container 'vllm' in 'vllm' has no resource limits. Set CPU and memory limits to prevent resource exhaustion and noisy-neighbor issues.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration K8S-031: Missing seccompProfile
findings.description: Container 'vllm' in 'vllm' has no seccompProfile set at container or pod level. Set seccompProfile.type to RuntimeDefault or Localhost to restrict syscalls.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration GHA-004: Workflow has no top-level permissions
findings.description: Without a top-level permissions: block the GITHUB_TOKEN gets the repository default, which may be write. Declare least-privilege permissions.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration DOCKER-006: No HEALTHCHECK directive
findings.description: No HEALTHCHECK instruction found. Add a HEALTHCHECK to enable container health monitoring and automatic restart on failure.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration K8S-021: No PodDisruptionBudget for Deployment 'vllm'
findings.description: Deployment 'vllm' has no matching PodDisruptionBudget in the same manifest. A PDB ensures minimum availability during voluntary disruptions like node drains.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration K8S-030: Deployment without PodAntiAffinity
findings.description: Deployment 'vllm' does not define podAntiAffinity. Without anti-affinity, all replicas may be scheduled on the same node, creating a single point of failure.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration K8S-022: Container without liveness probe
findings.description: Container 'vllm' in 'vllm' has no livenessProbe. Without a liveness probe, Kubernetes cannot detect and restart deadlocked or unresponsive containers.

findings.title: IaC misconfiguration K8S-023: Container without readiness probe
findings.description: Container 'vllm' in 'vllm' has no readinessProbe. Without a readiness probe, traffic is sent to pods before they are ready to serve requests.

findings.title: Model artifact could not be scanned: churn.pt
findings.description: Pickle opcode scan could not complete (no deserialization attempted): not a readable zip archive: File is not a zip file
findings.remediation_guidance: The static pickle scan could not complete, so this artifact carries NO malicious-payload verdict. Treat it as unverified: re-fetch it from its authoritative source and re-scan.
